score_rationale: Every blocking finding from the two prior rounds is fixed at this hash: the extension_predicate block exists, statement_formal resolves, the frozen gate passes exit 0, and canonical/mirror/FROZEN finally agree at one hash with verify_frozen 0 problems. Leakage and inflation remain clean. Revise is driven by one artifact-level blocking finding carried by precedent: the disjunctive D0 makes the artifact a family of class statements, which the project already adjudicated as not acceptable for class identity (map reviews[43], reviews[70]) and which is exactly G-FORM's unmet 'no single frozen data class (s,delta,norm)' criterion. Not reject: the repair is a freeze decision the owner can make in one revision (instantiate one regularity setting; register the other as a variant). Not accept: one class_id currently denotes >=2 statements with different ambient spaces and comeagerness notions.

B.label: B
B.axis: class identity / quantifier domain not frozen
B.statement: quantifiers.formal (line 45) and conclusion.statement_formal (line 215) both range 'forall (s,delta) in D0', and D0 (line 55) is the disjunction 'Sobolev variant s > 5/2 and delta in (1/2,1), OR the smooth-with-decay default'; the same disjunction is repeated in regularity.data_regularity (line 146). D1's comeagerness is defined against 'the named topology' (line 58), and the named topology differs per disjunct: the weighted Sobolev product H^s_delta x H^{s-1}_{delta+1} for the Sobolev variant vs the Frechet topology for the smooth-with-decay class (lines 160-161). Since genericity.is_part_of_class is true and the artifact's own class_change_warning (line 166) says that changing the genericity notion yields a different class, one class_id now denotes at least two class statements with different ambient spaces, different topologies and different comeagerness notions. The falsifier semantics split with it: tier_1 refutes the class by exhibiting one (s,delta) in D0 whose extendible set is non-meager (existential over D0), so a single-regularity counterexample would refute the whole class while leaving the other disjunct untouched -- a strictly weaker statement than a frozen single-data-class class, and the opposite of the direction a class-bound verdict needs.
B.detector: artifacts/flash-15/convergence/recheck_canonical_rev9.py (yaml.safe_load; D0 disjunct census, ambient-topology census) -> artifacts/flash-15/convergence/a1_recheck_canonical_rev9.json#4d50de57ed00 (checks.D0_disjuncts, checks.ambient_topologies_named, checks.genericity_is_part_of_class)
B.adjudicated_precedent: research_map/research_map.json#e92d9968742e reviews[43].findings[0] ('quantifiers.formal ranges over a disjunctive D0 ... so this is a family of two class statements', supersedes an earlier accept) and reviews[70].findings[1] ('Q2 disjunctive D0: not acceptable for class identity; revision 6 removes it ... G-FORM's one-data-class criterion is blocked pending the freeze decision'). G-FORM's own unmet list (research_map.json#e92d9968742e gates[1].unmet[3]) requires 'a single frozen data class (s,delta,norm) shared by F1/F2a/F2b'. F2b/rev6 removed its disjunctive domain for this reason (reviews/F2-review-18.json#ab26b92bf16a).
B.correlated: deepseek-flash-05 blocker w05-f2a-audit-20260912T001155-blocker records probe S6-C2 with the same conclusion; this entry is the A1 verdict at the reviewed hash, not a duplicate charge.
B.artifact_counter_argument: class_boundary.data_versus_extension_classes (line 86) argues data regularity is a separate axis from the extension-class token. That is true of the class token and false of the class statement: the schemas' own genericity block makes the ambient space, topology and genericity kind part of the class identity, and those change with the D0 member, so the forall-over-D0 form is a schema family, not one class.
B.remedy: One freeze decision, one revision: instantiate exactly one regularity setting in D0/statement_formal (either the Sobolev pair or the smooth-with-decay default) and register the other as a variant with a variant_id per VARIANT_REGISTRY.json policy; emit the artifact event with the new sha256 and regenerate FROZEN.json. Do not start another rewrite loop.
B.falsifier: A revision whose quantifiers.domains.D0 definition and regularity.data_regularity contain no disjunction (a single regularity setting), whose statement_formal instantiates that setting, and which still exits 0 on check_class_schema.py at the new canonical hash with FROZEN binding canonical == mirror == that hash. If instead the owner publishes an explicit class-level ruling that the D0 family reading is intended, the ruling must name the affected falsifier semantics and be accepted by lead-audit before a G-FORM verdict.

N.label: N
N.axis: normative text contradicts the binding implication ledger
N.statement: regularity.must_not_conflate[2] (line 155) reads 'a C0 result does not establish this class: it is stronger, and the implication runs C0 => C2 only'. The second clause and implication_ledger.one_way_entailments[0] (line 241, 'no proper future C0 extension' entails 'no proper future C2 extension', status elementary) say the opposite of the first clause: if the implication runs C0 => C2, a C0 inextendibility result DOES establish this class's conclusion. Only the class identity (C0 is a different class) is not established. Non-blocking because the binding ledger is correct and R16-compliant, and the repair is one clause; but the sentence as written could be used to refuse a licensed entailment.
N.remedy: Reword to 'a C0 result is not this class; it is stronger and entails this class's conclusion (C0 => C2), while the converse transfer is forbidden'.
N.falsifier: A revision in which the must_not_conflate sentence and the ledger entry assert the same direction.

N.label: N
N.statement: The top-level key revised_at occurs 7 times as a live key (plus revised_at_unused). yaml.safe_load silently keeps the last one (2026-09-12T00:15:00), which is 4m45s AHEAD of the file mtime (2026-09-12 00:10:15); a strict duplicate-key loader rejects the document at line 10. The gate tool uses safe_load, so this is invisible to the gate but is a provenance hazard for any reviewer that binds to declared times, and it will break tools that adopt strict loaders. (FROZEN rev23's frozen_at 00:26:00 is likewise ~11 min ahead of wall clock at review time; lead-audit already recorded the manifest half of this in reviews/A1-rebind-coverage.json.)

N.label: N
N.statement: falsifier.tier_1.machine_checkable_steps lists 'the extension's metric is C2 across the boundary and Ric = 0 holds at sample points'. Sampled derivative checks cannot certify twice continuous differentiability at a boundary; they can only bound finite-difference residuals on samples. The step should read 'sampled C2-consistency residual below tolerance' or move the C2-across-boundary claim to non_machine_checkable_step alongside non-meagerness. (Same axis as the reviewer's N1 at rev3; carried forward, not resolved by the revision.)
N.remedy: Reword the machine-checkable step; keep the honest non_machine_checkable_step (non-meagerness) as is.
N.falsifier: A falsifier block whose machine-checkable steps are all decidable by a bounded numerical check.
